reviews.comment:
Muy buena Atencion del tipo ACA aunque estan desactivados los servicios Mecanicos y de Grua que tenia en el pasado por lo que me dijeron llame a Salta. Pero enfrente en el Cerro esta el mejor HOTEL Y Restaurante con vista panoramica de todo CACHI que es del ACA Visitenlo no se van arrepentir!!

(Translated by Google)
Excellent service from the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina) branch, although the mechanical and towing services they used to offer are no longer available, so I was told to call Salta. But across the street on the hill is the best hotel and restaurant with panoramic views of all of Cachi, which is also an ACA branch. Visit it, you won't regret it!
